issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns an int, but the solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a StudentCount object. This mismatch between the expected return type (int) and the solution's return type (StudentCount) is likely to confuse students and cause issues when they follow the specification or when tests/checks expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (sum of inscribed and guest students) and update calls accordingly, matching the UML and problem text; or (B) update the problem statement and UML to document and require a StudentCount return type (and add StudentCount to the template), including documentation on how students should use it. Option A is recommended for simplicity and to match the current UML.
